description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:274-279 — DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains(substring) match calls cert.tbs_certificate.issuer.to_string() then .to_lowercase() (two allocations) and substring.to_lowercase() (one allocation) for every deviation check. Fix: store the substring pre-lowercased in IssuerDnContains at construction time (Deviation::add can enforce this). Then only one to_lowercase allocation per check.
title: IssuerDnContains substring match allocates two String copies per check
